v0.4.8 · 2026-11-10

Native Neural Execution

GitHub Release ↗

Infernux 0.4.8 brings model authoring, native execution, and checkpoint export into the engine. Projects can connect neural inputs and outputs to their own game systems through the same resource and lifecycle boundaries used by rendering and physics.

Compare with v0.4.3-v8

Neural runtime

  • Define models with infernux.nn and run supported training and inference on native CPU or Vulkan. Managed requests keep their intermediate state across host frames and publish results at the consumer boundary.
  • Use a shared host-frame budget for ready work, including headless execution. RenderGraph and NeuralGraph keep independent dependencies and share device submission and completion infrastructure.
  • Save a published model in an .inm checkpoint with a readable structure header and binary weights. Projects can reload it for inference or continued training in the Editor or a matching packaged Player.

Rendering, scenes, and authoring

  • Capture camera views continuously or on request. Cameras can publish to a RenderTexture asset or to memory, and consumers can keep using the latest completed image.
  • Expose editable skeleton hierarchies and Jolt joints and ragdolls. Model results can be applied at explicit physics and rendering boundaries.
  • Improve asset preparation and preview publication with shared IO and transfer budgets. Native PNG and JPEG paths reserve their decoding workspace. Asset refresh, watching, and model Apply use the native sidecar parser and preserve the revision they consumed.
  • Prepare scene geometry on open using bounded Vulkan upload batches. Scene camera movement updates gizmo icons in the current frame and keeps their picking aligned.
  • Bundle MCP 0.2.1 with restored checkpoint operations. The official catalog includes Tween 0.3.1 and Text Animator 0.1.4, which handles empty animation curves.
  • Update the Hub and platform packaging for engine 0.4.8. Install platform packages built for this exact engine release before exporting a Player.

v0.4.8 · 2026-11-10

原生神经计算

GitHub Release ↗

Infernux 0.4.8 将模型定义、原生执行和检查点导出纳入引擎。项目可以通过资源和生命周期接口，将神经计算的输入与结果接到自己的渲染、物理和其他游戏系统。

与 v0.4.3-v8 比较

神经计算

  • 通过 infernux.nn 定义模型，在原生 CPU 或 Vulkan 上执行受支持的训练和推理。受管请求可跨宿主帧保留中间状态，并在结果使用方需要的阶段发布。
  • 就绪工作共享宿主帧预算，无窗口运行时也可继续推进。RenderGraph 和 NeuralGraph 各自管理依赖，共用设备提交和完成记录。
  • 用 .inm 检查点保存已发布的模型，文件包含可读的结构头和二进制权重。编辑器和对应版本的 Player 可以读取检查点并执行推理或续训。

渲染、场景和编辑

  • 相机支持连续或按请求渲染，可输出到 RenderTexture 资产或内存。使用方可继续显示最近一次完成的图像。
  • 提供可编辑的骨骼层级以及 Jolt 关节和布娃娃。模型结果可以在指定的物理或渲染阶段生效。
  • 资产准备和预览发布共用 IO 与传输预算。原生 PNG 和 JPEG 解码先预约工作内存。资产刷新、文件监听和模型 Apply 使用原生侧车解析器，并保留实际读取的文件代次。
  • 打开场景时分批上传网格。移动 Scene 相机会当帧更新 Gizmo 图标，拾取与显示位置保持一致。
  • 内置 MCP 0.2.1，恢复检查点操作。官方插件目录提供 Tween 0.3.1 和支持空动画曲线的 Text Animator 0.1.4。
  • Hub 与平台打包对齐到引擎 0.4.8。导出 Player 时使用与引擎发布版本一致的平台包。
